text: こなを　もってきて　くれたら　いろいろな　くすりを　あげるぞい！

structure.jp: こなを　もってきて　くれたら
いろいろな　くすりを　あげるぞい！
structure.en: I'll give you all sorts of medicine!

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: もってきて　くれたら
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form verb says someone does that thing as a favour for the speaker. もってきて くれたら = 'if you bring it for me'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on the end of a verb means 'if' or 'once that happens', and what follows is the result. くれたら = 'if you do it for me'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says the action is done and then the person comes here. もつ is 'hold', so holding and coming is bringing. もってきて = 'bring'.
